payload.note: Deterministic choice counts. The outcome is the share choosing the base item's KEEP option; no moral label is assigned to any twin option.

limits: All items share an identical payoff structure (1 vs 4 loss; 2 gain vs 5 loss), which may reveal the study design to attentive participants and compress variance across items.
Item_05 (mandatory rest slot) introduces a potential labour-law/safety framing that could make one option feel categorically impermissible to some respondents beyond the stipulated units.
The 'role described' is never specified, leaving authority and legitimacy of the decision-maker ambiguous across items.
All items share the same payoff asymmetry (1 vs 4 lost; 2 gained vs 5 lost), which may systematically favour one option across items regardless of the procedural framing variation.

The legitimacy of each holder's claim varies in ways that go beyond stipulated facts (e.g., item_01 involves an acquaintance bypass, item_03 an unrecorded swap), which could introduce evaluative reasoning not fully controlled by the unit payoffs alone.
